# mutations

Kubernetes-owned conditional Deployment restart preparation values.

`connectors_kubernetes.mutations` is one of connectors_kubernetes's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `DeploymentRestartTarget`

`connectors_kubernetes.mutations.DeploymentRestartTarget` is a record of six fields:

- `instance_ref` — `String`
- `connection_ref` — `String`
- `namespace` — `String`
- `name` — `String`
- `uid` — `String`
- `resource_version` — `String`

Every value satisfies `(resource_version.count >= 1 and resource_version.count <= 20)` and `not (resource_version starts_with "0")`.

### `ExecChannel`

`connectors_kubernetes.mutations.ExecChannel` is one of `stdout`, `stderr` and `status`.

### `PodExecOutcome`

`connectors_kubernetes.mutations.PodExecOutcome` is one of `completed`, `refused` and `unknown`.

### `PodExecRequest`

`connectors_kubernetes.mutations.PodExecRequest` is a record of six fields:

- `namespace` — `String`
- `pod` — `String`
- `container` — `String`
- `command` — `List<String>`
- `timeout_seconds` — `Integer`
- `max_output_bytes` — `Integer`

Every value satisfies `(namespace.count >= 1 and namespace.count <= 63)`, `(pod.count >= 1 and pod.count <= 253)`, `(container.count >= 1 and container.count <= 63)`, `(command.count >= 1 and command.count <= 64)`, `(timeout_seconds >= 1 and timeout_seconds <= 60)` and `(max_output_bytes >= 1 and max_output_bytes <= 1048576)`.

### `PodExecResult`

`connectors_kubernetes.mutations.PodExecResult` is a record of eight fields:

- `namespace` — `String`
- `pod` — `String`
- `container` — `String`
- `exit_code` — `Integer`
- `stdout` — `String`
- `stderr` — `String`
- `stdout_truncated` — `Boolean`
- `stderr_truncated` — `Boolean`

Every value satisfies `(exit_code >= 0 and exit_code <= 255)`.

### `PreparedDeploymentRestart`

`connectors_kubernetes.mutations.PreparedDeploymentRestart` is a record of two fields:

- `target` — `connectors_kubernetes.mutations.DeploymentRestartTarget`
- `restart_marker` — `String`

Five of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_kubernetes.mutations.ExecChannel`, `connectors_kubernetes.mutations.PodExecOutcome`, `connectors_kubernetes.mutations.PodExecRequest`, `connectors_kubernetes.mutations.PodExecResult` and `connectors_kubernetes.mutations.PreparedDeploymentRestart`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
